processors.script: const request = JSON.parse(context.getBody() || '{}'); const query = request.query || ''; const purpose = (((query[0] === '?' ? query.substring(1) : query).split('&').find((pair) => pair.indexOf('purpose=') === 0) || '').split('=')[1] || 'sign'); const decodedPurpose = decodeURIComponent(purpose); const response = JSON.parse(context.sendToStep('keygen-remote', 'key-gen', JSON.stringify({ purpose: decodedPurpose })).getBody() || '{}'); context.setHeader('content-type', 'application/json'); context.setBody(JSON.stringify({ ok: response.ok === true, purpose: response.purpose || null, encoding: response.encoding || null, hasPublicKey: typeof response.keyPair?.publicKeyHex === 'string' && response.keyPair.publicKeyHex.length > 0, hasSecretKey: typeof response.keyPair?.secretKeyHex === 'string' && response.keyPair.secretKeyHex.length > 0 }));
